event_data.context: Filesystem journal merged in PR #4. PR #5 signed head 511729e passes all 29 local tests. It preserves imported empty decisions, and fork inspection skips shared pre-fork ancestry and retains one branch's traversal state at a time. A synthetic 20,000-transaction shared prefix with 64 branches took 58 ms locally, down from 824 ms. All prior threads are resolved and final CI and App review are pending. Rust issue #45 is open. Clean Nix SQLite passed 33 tests. The isolated PostgreSQL and snapshot prototype now passes 41 tests, including a real two-pool PostgreSQL 18.6 contract.
event_data.summary: Port and verify the durable storage and command state capabilities of EventCore 2.1.0 on Erlang/OTP.
event_data.title: Durable storage and command state
